from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NonCurrentAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the financial statement")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date of the reporting period")
    total_non_current_assets: float | None = Field(description="The reported or calculated total non-current asset value")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_records: list[NonCurrentAssetRecord]
